name: Vorzani Conjecture
description: An ancient unsolved magical and mathematical ritual about infinite sequences of unpredictable mana, said to hold the essence of the universe.

timeline.summary: Zimone takes out the Vorzani Conjecture book from the Biblioplex, last signed out by Nimiroti.
timeline.quote: Zimone had peeped into the record scroll as Isabough's branches reached to the farthest shelves to find the book.

pages_say.description: An ancient unsolved magical and mathematical ritual about infinite sequences of unpredictable mana, said to hold the essence of the universe.
A theory that the Multiverse seeks observation; Zimone cites it.
